title: Extending the Partial Copy Guide
statement: For every natural number $j$, updating the partial copy guide at coordinate $j$ with the origin mark if $j=0$ and the interior mark otherwise yields the partial copy guide for $j+1$ copied input cells.
replaced:
Updating the partial guide with $j$ copied cells at cell $j$ --- writing the origin
mark when $j = 0$ and an interior mark otherwise --- yields the partial guide with
$j+1$ copied cells.
